b2-35-01.title: Communicative Challenge: When the Machine Can Start
b2-35-01.scenario: On the island of Faremidó, Gulliver asks you, his fellow traveller, when the new machine can start working.
b2-35-01.prompt: Tell Gulliver under what condition the machine can start.
b2-35-01.target: Amennyiben a kísérlet sikerül, úgy a gép elindulhat.
b2-35-01.english: If the experiment succeeds, the machine can start.
b2-35-01.canDo: I can state a condition with amennyiben and abban az esetben, ha

b2-35-02.title: Communicative Challenge: What Would Have Happened
b2-35-02.scenario: On the shore of Faremidó, Gulliver asks you what would have happened if the engineers had noticed the error of the machine in time.
b2-35-02.prompt: Tell Gulliver what would have happened.
cues: Say what the engineers did not do in time
Say what would have happened to the machine
b2-35-02.target: Ha a mérnökök időben észrevették volna a hibát, a gép nem romlott volna el.
b2-35-02.english: Had the engineers noticed the error in time, the machine would not have broken down.
b2-35-02.canDo: I can stack several conditions with ha ... volna to say what would have happened

b2-35-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Who Decides?
b2-35-03.scenario: The inorganic being of Faremidó asks you whether machines will take over the work and the decisions of people.
b2-35-03.prompt: Tell the being what machines will probably do and who decides.
cues: Say what the machines will probably do
b2-35-03.target: A gépek valószínűleg sok feladatot megoldanak, de a döntés az emberé marad.
b2-35-03.english: The machines will probably solve many tasks, but the decision stays with people.
b2-35-03.canDo: I can say what happens to tasks without naming a doer, with -ásra/-ésre kerül

b2-35-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Rules for Gene Modification
b2-35-04.scenario: Gulliver asks you whether people may cure a disease by gene modification and what rules are needed.
b2-35-04.prompt: Tell Gulliver what rules are needed and why.
cues: Say what is needed for the patients
Say why the rules are needed
b2-35-04.target: A betegek védelme érdekében szigorú szabályok kellenek, mert a génmódosítás veszélyes lehet.
b2-35-04.english: Strict rules are needed to protect the patients, because gene modification can be dangerous.
b2-35-04.canDo: I can ask what is allowed in gene modification with szabad-e and tilos

b2-35-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Chances and Risks
b2-35-05.scenario: Before he leaves Faremidó, the inorganic being asks you to say in a few sentences what the future of machines will bring.
b2-35-05.prompt: Tell the being about the chances and the risks, and close with your conclusion.
cues: Give one good side and one risk
b2-35-05.target: Egyrészt a gépek sok munkát megoldanak, másrészt új kockázatokat is hoznak. Végül a szabályozásnak időben kell érkeznie.
b2-35-05.english: On the one hand the machines solve a lot of work, on the other hand they also bring new risks. Finally the regulation must arrive in time.
b2-35-05.canDo: I can build a short essay on the future with egyrészt ... másrészt, amennyiben ..., úgy and végül

b2-35-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Machines and Human Decisions
b2-35-consolidation.scenario: Gulliver asks you what happens to people if machines decide in their place.
b2-35-consolidation.prompt: Tell Gulliver what happens to people in that case.
b2-35-consolidation.target: Amennyiben a gépek döntenek az emberek helyett, úgy az emberek elveszítik a cselekvőképességüket.
b2-35-consolidation.english: If the machines decide instead of people, people lose their capacity to act.
b2-35-consolidation.canDo: I can state conditions and counterfactual scenarios about technology in Hungarian
